name: io.github.sepehr071/iran-roads-mcp
title: Iran Roads
description: Read-only Iran road status (141.ir): bulletins, closures, restrictions, road works, weather.

environmentVariables.name: IRAN_ROADS_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the 141.ir requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
